title: KEK rotation simulator and tamper-evident evidence signer for residency/retention audits
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a KEK (key-encryption-key) rotation simulation harness plus a signed, tamper-evident evidence artifact generator that proves: which KEK version encrypted tenant keys, when rotations occurred, and which physical regions the HSM operations ran in. This ticket covers engineering the simulation, integrating with our KMS adapters (cloud KMS and on-prem HSM proxies), adding deterministic event signing, and a compact provenance bundle format suitable for audit uploads and long-term retention. The goal is to enable automated submission of rotation evidence to customer compliance requests and to feed the Console's residency and retention dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can run a representative rotation sequence (create, wrap, unwrap, retire) against cloud-KMS and HSM-stub backends without touching production keys
Evidence signer produces an immutable, cryptographically-signed bundle per-rotation with fields: keK_id, wrapped_key_id, rotation_timestamp, actor, region, KMS_backend_fingerprint
Bundles verifyable with public key in our compliance repo and match logs in the rotation event stream
End-to-end test in CI demonstrates generation + verification and an example upload to the compliance S3 bucket (retention 7 years)
No production secret material is exported; simulator uses ephemeral test keys and HSM emulation
Design and API documented in Confluence + sample consumer script for Console ingestion
tasks: Design evidence bundle schema and signing algorithm (compact JSON-LD + detached signature)
Implement rotation simulator harness with pluggable KMS adapters
Add HSM proxy adapter that records attestation metadata (firmware version, slot id)
Implement deterministic signing: keypair rotation for evidence signer and publish verification key to compliance repo
Create CI integration test that runs simulator and verifies bundle signatures
Wire a small ingestion lambda to accept bundles and store to compliance S3 with immutability tags
Document API and create example Console dashboard ingestion doc

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Test HSM attestation may not reflect production hardware behaviour. Mitigation: include attestation fingerprint mapping and require live-HSM smoke test during Dedicated onboarding.
Risk: Evidence bundles may leak metadata with PII in debug fields. Mitigation: schema excludes tenant data beyond stable identifiers; all debug fields must be redacted by default.

Risk: Verification key rotation for the signer could break historical verification. Mitigation: signer publishes a small key history manifest signed by offline root; bundles record signer_key_id. Long-term archival policy must preserve signer public keys.
review_feedback: PM (Lina Gomez): prefer schema that supports per-tenant override of retention expirations; included as optional field in bundle
Security (J. Park): require deterministic signing and key ID embedding so offline auditors can replay verification
Design (E. Rios): add compact human-readable summary alongside machine bundle for quick auditor review
